title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 435 (Establishment of Special Courts)

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Central Government may establish Special Courts for the speedy trial of offences under the Act.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A Special Court is a Court of Session. Offences under the Act are tried there, except as the Act allocates a lesser offence to a Magistrate.
